title: eludite.terminal.clear input
description: Clear a terminal (the window's Clear): its screen and scrollback are erased and the cursor goes to the top; the shell and its command keep running. Marks stay valid: output printed later is still read with eludite.terminal.read `mode: since`. For agents, class execute decided by the solution policy's `terminal.run`.

terminal.description: The terminal: its id from eludite.terminal.open or eludite.terminal.list (`term1`, `term2`, ...). Default: the active terminal of the Terminal window (the one last opened or selected).
